title: Frequent-Flyer Tax Credit for Crestline Companion Tickets
content:
Holders of Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes who fly often receive a frequent-flyer tax credit against the companion's taxes and fees. It follows the Crestline flight accrual entries posted to the holder's Summit membership in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program in the last 12 months, counted back from the handling date.

| Crestline flight accrual entries in the last 12 months | Frequent-flyer tax credit |
|---|---|
| 12 or more | 8 USD |
| 6 to fewer than 12 | 4 USD |
| fewer than 6 | nothing |

Only flight accrual entries count; partner, purchase and qualifying-dollar entries do not.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical).** 12 flight accruals give 8 USD and 11 give 4 USD; 6 give 4 USD and 5 give nothing.
